# Ideas for v11: what should come next?
v10 brought the version launcher, theater mode (Esc), the login panorama, Squid Game Epic Edition as its own world and resource gathering.

Some directions we are considering:
- Use gathered resources for something: recipes, crafting or trading them for MVC
- More separate worlds in the Worlds tab
- A shared screenshot gallery for every place

Post your idea as a reply, or open a new discussion in Ideas.
